chapters.title: Plain recursion

frames.caption: Plain recursion — O(2n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: minimum_total(triangle=[[-1], [2, 3], [1, -1, -3]]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
def f(r, i): (cheapest path from (r, i) to the base)
return triangle[r][i] + min(f(r + 1, i), f(r + 1, i + 1)) — calls f(r=1, i=0)
return triangle[r][i] + min(f(r + 1, i), f(r + 1, i + 1)) — calls f(r=2, i=0)
return triangle[r][i] + min(f(r + 1, i), f(r + 1, i + 1)) — calls f(r=3, i=0)
return triangle[r][i] + min(f(r + 1, i), f(r + 1, i + 1)) — calls f(r=3, i=1)
return triangle[r][i] + min(f(r + 1, i), f(r + 1, i + 1)) — calls f(r=2, i=1)
return triangle[r][i] + min(f(r + 1, i), f(r + 1, i + 1)) — calls f(r=3, i=1)
return triangle[r][i] + min(f(r + 1, i), f(r + 1, i + 1)) — calls f(r=3, i=2)
